- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Handley Page Limited no longer exists as a company actively manufacturing aircraft; it was liquidated in 1970.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Handley Page Association was founded in 1998 to preserve the heritage of the company and its contributions to the aviation industry.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Handley Page Association holds archives, documents, and artifacts related to Handley Page and organizes events and exhibitions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Handley Page Museum is located at the former airfield site in Radlett, Hertfordshire.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The museum displays a range of Handley Page aircraft, including the Halifax, Victor, and Herald.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The museum features exhibits on the company's history, innovations, and contributions to aviation.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Other exhibitions and events organized by the Handley Page Association take place at various locations throughout the UK.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Handley Page Museum is a fascinating place to visit, especially for those interested in aviation history.
